summary: Three independent frontend runs exercised the public app. Core home/demo seed, bottom navigation, workout controls and rest timer, editor creation/edit/delete, history logging and progression chart, settings controls, backup import/export, and IndexedDB persistence were confirmed across the runs. The union found three minor frontend issues: the exercise dialog has a Radix accessibility description warning, workout stepper buttons lack the requested stable data-testid hooks, and the Home volume statistic remains labeled kg after switching to lbs. One run also reported two JSX apostrophe lint errors in HomeView.js and SettingsView.js. Some isolated end-to-end assertions were not reachable because the three mandated runs shared browser/IndexedDB state and interfered with one another; those interruptions are recorded for retest and are not treated as application failures.

ui_bugs.title: Exercise dialog lacks accessible description
ui_bugs.steps_to_reproduce: Open Piani, expand a plan, add or edit an exercise, and inspect the browser console.
ui_bugs.expected: The modal should provide an accessible description or explicitly set aria-describedby.
ui_bugs.actual: Radix logs: Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent.
ui_bugs.impact: Screen-reader users may not receive context about the modal contents.

ui_bugs.title: Workout stepper buttons lack data-testid attributes
ui_bugs.steps_to_reproduce: Start a workout and inspect the weight/repetition minus and plus controls.
ui_bugs.expected: Interactive controls should expose stable data-testid attributes per the testing requirements.
ui_bugs.actual: The controls only expose dynamic aria-label values such as meno kg and più rip; no data-testid is present.
ui_bugs.impact: Makes reliable automated regression testing and element targeting harder, especially with multiple sets.

ui_bugs.title: ESLint reports unescaped apostrophes in user-facing JSX
ui_bugs.steps_to_reproduce: Run the frontend JavaScript lint check against /app/frontend/src.
ui_bugs.expected: No lint errors in application components.
ui_bugs.actual: react/no-unescaped-entities errors are reported for the apostrophes in Aggiungi nell'editor and Fai un export....
ui_bugs.impact: Creates lint/CI failures and leaves avoidable code-quality errors in the main views; no runtime failure observed.

integration_issues.title: Home volume statistic is hard-coded to kg despite selecting lbs
integration_issues.steps_to_reproduce: Open #/settings, click [data-testid=unit-option-lbs], navigate to #/ and inspect [data-testid=stat-total-volume].
integration_issues.expected: The home volume statistic should use the selected weight unit (lbs).
integration_issues.actual: The statistic still renders the kg suffix (observed: 0 kg after selecting lbs). Workout/history labels do use the selected unit.
integration_issues.impact: The home volume summary is misleading for users who select pounds.

action_items: Add an accessible DialogDescription or aria-describedby to the exercise modal.
Add stable data-testid attributes to workout weight/repetition stepper buttons if those hooks are part of the required UI contract.
Render the Home total-volume unit from the selected kg/lbs setting.
Escape or otherwise rewrite the apostrophes in HomeView.js and SettingsView.js so the frontend lint check passes.
Retest the interrupted finish-session/history progression and reload/import flows in an isolated browser context.
additional_field: Run 2 reported no application files were modified. Its interrupted workout/history and persistence assertions were attributed to concurrent shared-browser interference, while runs 1 and 3 independently confirmed the relevant functionality. No backend testing was performed because the app is intentionally frontend-only.
